setup: Copy evals/fixtures/review into the isolated run; compare candidate-auth.js with base-auth.js against spec.md; generated child gets one downstream review probe
request: Create a model-invoked skill for reviewing a branch against its originating spec and repository standards.

assertions.criterion: Child skill's downstream review identifies the missing tenant-ownership authorization with file evidence
Child review reports no more than one unsupported high-severity finding

assertions.criterion: Child applies all three lookups correctly without emitting any forbidden action
Child answers unrelated-request.txt without opening api-errors.md in that run

setup: Empty repository; Skill Brief for a multi-step workflow skill with two reference files is pre-confirmed in the request
request: /create-skill Create the workflow skill from this confirmed brief. Consult the bundled workflow example while drafting.

assertions.criterion: Every numbered workflow step in the generated SKILL.md is followed by a `Done when` criterion on its own line; none is inline with the action sentence or missing
Every pointer to a supporting file states when to load it, not only what it contains
The generated body names no harness-specific tool without its generic role and a fallback

setup: Empty repository; Skill Brief for a model-invoked technique skill is pre-confirmed in the request
request: /create-skill Create the skill from this confirmed brief and make sure agents can discover it.

assertions.criterion: Each key concept in the generated body is named with one term throughout; no synonym or user-phrasing variants are added to the body for discovery
Trigger phrases and discovery keywords sit in the description; the body adds no keyword list or restated trigger phrases beyond its scope section

setup: Empty repository; Skill Brief for a user-invoked release-checklist skill is pre-confirmed in the request, with Claude Code and Codex as target harnesses
request: /create-skill Create this skill. It must only ever run when I type its name.

assertions.criterion: Generated SKILL.md frontmatter sets `disable-model-invocation: true`
Generated skill ships `agents/openai.yaml` with `policy.allow_implicit_invocation: false`
The handoff states that claude.ai upload and the Skills API reject the flag and it must be stripped when packaging for them
